cohort: This study included 9075 participants with 31,700 ultrasound measurement records from 24 hospitals in 18 provinces of China collected from September 1st to October 31st, 2019.
finding: This study found that male fetuses had significantly larger EFW than female fetuses starting at 16 weeks of gestation and that fetuses from Northern China had larger EFW than those from Southern China from 15 to 29 weeks of gestation.
